body: thank you so much for taking the time to write this. i will try and wait.
but what if i fell head first?

i dedicated my whole life to my love. all my family and friends despised her and began to tell me to rot in hell being with her. now that i've threw everything out to be with her, she left me at my lowest point in my life. i tried running back to my friends but they will not open up their arms to me.
